title: Hum Hussaini Hai
body:
hussain hussain hussain
hum hussaini hai dunya mein phaile huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhtiyan karbala ki hai jhele huwe
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pe saaya wafa aur wafadar ka
dhoop mein jaise saaya ho dewaar ka
sar pe parcham hai sheh ke alamdar ka
har qadam bad rahe hai ye kehte hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dharti agar laal shehbaaz ki
laal shehbaaz ke bhi wali hai ali
sarfarazi isi dar se sab ko mili
wajd mein kyun na har ek qalandar kahe
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khwaja ajmer ho ya nizam o fareed
sheh ke dushman ko kehte hai ye bhi yazeed
sheh ka gham inke maslak mein haq ki naveed
kitne aizaaz inko ye keh kar milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haq parasti ke dunya mein haami raho
gar ho mazloom zaalim ko badne na do
zer e khanjar hussaini sada wo suno
aaj bhi jis se zaalim hai dehle hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mard wo hai jo waade ko poora kare
zer e khanjar bhi haq baat kehta rahe
sar rahe ya na rahe ghar lutay ya bache
juz tere aur kis mein hai ye hausle
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aandhiyan hum ko roke ye mumkin nahi
moo gham e sheh se moday ye mumkin nahi
rasme gham kaise choday ye mumkin nahi
hum to roz e azal se hi tere hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kul e emaan mushkil kusha hai ali
keh rahe hai nusairi khuda hai ali
ye khuda jaanta hai ke kya hai ali
saare ausaaf hyder ke tujh mein milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber o khandaq o nehrwaan o jamal
zarb e hyder ka koi nahi hai badal
ay zamane kabhi raah e hyder pe chal
tere dil bhi milega ye kehte hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadaar hai kitne khuddaar hai
de ke khushiyan jo gham ke talabgaar hai
shadi o gham mein sarwar ke ghamkhwar hai
ek hi naam hai lab kabhi jo hilay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk roke agar hum to phat jaye dil
gar na matam kare hum to kat jaye dil
apne markaz se mehwar se hat jaye dil
teri bazme aza gar na hum ko milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo roz e ashoora wo sheh ki behan
dekhti thi ujadta jo apna chaman
khoon e akbar se gul rang tha pairahan
de rahi thi sada ban mein sar peet ke
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
teri maadar ka shab ko janaza utha
teri hamsheer balwe mein hai berida
haye tujhko kafan bhi nahi mil saka
zakhm ab tak hamare nahi wo bhare
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nanhi si turbat banayi thi jab
bekasi pursa dene ko aayi thi jab
laashe asghar zameen mein chupayi thi jab
daaman e sabr choota na kyun haath se
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
koi pooche to abid ke dil se zara
tay safar shaam o kufa ka kaise kiya
betiyan fatema ki thi jab berida
chalne dete na thay paaon ke aabile
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay rehaan azmi fikr ho bas yehi
matam e sheh mein hone na paaye kami
hai yehi zindagi hai yehi bandagi
mere ajdaad bhi mujh se ye keh gaye
hussain hussain hussain
author: Rehaan Azmi
